messages:
Mike R: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's incident — feature-flag rollout went wider than expected in eu-west and that revealed a regional dependency. Need to lock down owners + timelines for remediation and a plan to avoid this pattern.
Anya (SRE): Agenda: assign remediation owners, set concrete timelines, add recurring-pattern checks to monitoring. I can own tightening canary thresholds and adding the hold gates.
Sophia (Eng Platform): +1. Proposed immediate items: 1) auto-rollback rule (>=5% error rate sustained for 2m) 2) per-region blast-radius cap (default 10%) 3) explicit small-batch rollout path with staged gates. I'll draft the config and PR today.
devops-bot: Deployment log: 2026-03-22T03:12:47Z rollback triggered by rule "error-rate-threshold" for deployment/feature/quick-indexer.
Sam P: Can we please get owners + rough deadlines? CS is asking. EOD Friday for a short plan would be ideal.
Lia (SRE): I can own the auto-rollback RFC + tests. ETA: RFC by next Tue, tests in CI by next release. I'll also add a synthetic test that simulates the eu-west pattern.
Mike R: Please add a metric 'failed_canary_count' and an eval harness for recurring pattern 'regional-memory-growth' — we saw the same symptom twice in the past 6 months.
Sophia (Eng Platform): I'll open two tickets: ENG-flagging-343 (blast-radius policy + UI), ENG-canary-344 (auto-rollback + config schema). Plan for rollout_percent steps: [1,5,20,100] with anomaly hold. Example config I plan to propose:
```
rollout_steps: [1,5,20,100]
hold_on_anomaly: true
anomaly_rule: 'errors >= 5% OR p95_latency > 2x baseline'
per_region_limit: 10%  # overrideable
```
Anya (SRE): Heads up — we need an ops dashboard and a dedicated alert that pages when auto-rollback triggers in prod. Also define whether auto-rollback should be allowed for hotfixes.
Sam P: PD rotation: oncall team will handle the pages. Lia, can you add the runbook steps for triage and customer comms?
Lia (SRE): Will do. Runbook draft by Thu. Also adding an alert for 'canary_fails_24h' and a daily digest of canary failures so recurring patterns surface.
Mike R: Ownership summary for the postmortem actions (I'll put this in the PM): - Auto-rollback RFC & CI tests: Lia - Blast-radius policy & UI changes: Sophia - Canary threshold tuning + hold gates: Anya - Runbook + paging + CS comms: Lia
Deadlines: Tickets created today, RFCs by Tue, runbook by Thu, E2E CI tests merged by next release. If anyone can't meet these, flag now.
Sophia (Eng Platform): Created ENG-flagging-343 and ENG-canary-344 and opened PRs #512 & #513. Linking the config PRs in the postmortem. @Lia please review PRs when you have a chance.
Lia (SRE): Will review tomorrow morning. Also adding metric 'canary_fails_24h' to the alerting dashboard. I'll link the runbook in the PR comments.
Mike R: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these actions and ping CS to follow up with impacted customers. Let's reconvene after RFCs are posted. :thumbsup:
